reason: Attacked on wording, on the page, on the numbering and on the poet's name, and it holds on all four. The Project Gutenberg transcription of the 1919 Knopf More Translations from the Chinese was downloaded and the poem read whole rather than summarised. Its title page reads MORE TRANSLATIONS FROM THE CHINESE BY ARTHUR WALEY, NEW YORK, ALFRED A KNOPF, MCMXIX, with COPYRIGHT, 1919, BY ALFRED A KNOPF, INC, so the named edition is the right one. The poem stands as [15] WATCHING THE REAPERS with the bracketed date A.D. 806 and ends: Thinking of this, secretly I grew ashamed; / And all day the thought lingered in my head. That is the shipped wording to the letter, including the comma after this, the semicolon after ashamed and the full stop at the end, and the lineation is Waley's two lines with Thinking and And at the heads. Nothing minted, no drift. The page is right, and it was worth checking because a 22 line poem can run over. The contents list gives Watching the Reapers 41 and the next poem, Going Alone to Spend a Night at the Hsien-Yu Temple, 42, so the whole poem including the closing couplet sits on page 41. The corrected note is accurate on both counts: the bracketed numbers run through the whole volume, since Sick Leave immediately before it is [14], and within the PO CHÜ-I section this is the fifth poem, after After Passing the Examination (37), Escorting Candidates to the Examination Hall (38), In Early Summer Lodging in a Temple to Enjoy the Moonlight (39) and Sick Leave (40), the Life of Po Chü-i at 35 being prose. So the earlier locator really was wrong and the correction really does fix it. Naming the poet Bai Juyi where Waley prints Po Chü-i is consistent with the year's practice for Du Fu and Li Bai carried out of Bynner, and the note says plainly what the edition prints. Attribution: Bai Juyi's poem, not on the misattribution list, the poet in his own voice, no speaker to name. Scope: A.D. 806, poetry, not scripture, not a lyric, no warning needed. Tag: Poetry, the form of the work. Cap: shipped.js gives bai juyi at 0 of 3, and po chu-i at 0 as well, so nothing hides behind the older romanisation; not banned, nothing shipped, no near opening, one appearance in the month's proposals. Source line: 124 characters, leads with the name, no dash, names the translator and the year of the translation whose wording it uses. Theme: an official who has never once tended field or tree, drawing three hundred tons of government pay while the reapers burn in the field, and ashamed of it all day. That is Justice and Service exactly, and shame that lingers in the head rather than any description of suffering, so it stays publishable and stays bearable at six in the morning.
